config.excamate.title: ExcaMate Settings
config.excamate.option.auto_torch: Auto torch placement in Branch mode
config.excamate.tooltip.auto_pickup: When enabled, ExcaMate tries to place mined drops directly into your inventory.
config.excamate.tooltip.direct_xp: When enabled, XP is awarded directly instead of spawning XP orbs.
config.excamate.tooltip.auto_torch: When enabled, ExcaMate places torches from your off-hand while branch mining.
config.excamate.tooltip.auto_replant: When enabled, ExcaMate replants supported crops using seeds or crops held in your off-hand.
config.excamate.tooltip.vein_max_blocks: Maximum total blocks broken by one Vein mode action.
config.excamate.tooltip.branch_max_block: Maximum total blocks broken by one Branch mode action.
config.excamate.tooltip.excamate_max_blo: Maximum total blocks broken by one Excavate mode action. The default 27 allows a full 3x3x3 excavation.
config.excamate.subtitle.extra_vein_mine: Adds extra blocks ExcaMate can mass-mine.
config.excamate.subtitle.vein_mine_block: Prevents listed blocks from being mass-mined.
config.excamate.subtitle.auto_pickup_blo: Prevents listed block drops from being auto-picked up.
config.excamate.note.block_lists: Search for a block, select it, then use the list's + button. Existing rows can be selected and removed with the list's - button.
